hooks.command: f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); case "$f" in *.c|*.cc|*.cpp|*.cxx|*.h|*.hh|*.hpp|*.hxx) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; clang-format -i --style=file --fallback-style=none "$f" >&2 || exit 2

f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); case "$f" in *.py) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; cd "$(dirname "$f")" || exit 2; ruff check --fix --quiet "$f" >&2; unfixed=$?; ruff format --silent "$f" >&2 || exit 2; [ "$unfixed" -eq 0 ] || exit 2
f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); case "$f" in *.py) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; cd "$(dirname "$f")" || exit 2; devcontainer-pyright "$f" >&2 || exit 2
hooks.statusMessage: Type-checking Python in the dev container

hooks.command: f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); case "$f" in *.tex) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; cd "$(dirname "$f")" || exit 2; t=$(mktemp) || exit 2; trap 'env rm -f "$t"' EXIT; latexindent --logfile=/dev/null -m -rv < "$f" > "$t" || exit 2; cat "$t" > "$f"

statusLine.command: dir=$(jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); branch=$(git -C "$dir" --no-optional-locks branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); printf '\033[1;36m%s\033[0m' "$(echo "$dir" | sed "s|^$HOME|~|")"; [ -n "$branch" ] && printf ' \033[1;35m%s\033[0m' "$branch"; echo
